name: Icecream
source: She is the student president of the school the protagonist is employed as a nurse. Her name when the protagonist meets her is Icecream, when she 'evolves' her name is [url=/c114204]Fruit Sundae[/url]. She is very protective of her younger classmate Pudding.  Her hobby is reading.  She hates direct sunlight and abiding by the school rules.  Her dream is to move somewhere that's cool year round.
